attachment-transfer-limits-description: Beakanya mellwane ya bogolo bjo bo fetago bja difaele tša go laiša le go taonelouta. Polokelo ya nakwana ya phetišetšo ya API e na le mellwane ya yona ya polokego ka lehlakoreng la sebara.
attachment-transfer-limits-invalid-value: Hle tsenya boleng bja mollwane bjo bo nepagetšego bja go feta lefeela
attachment-transfer-limits-saved: Mellwane ya phetišetšo ya dikgomaretšwa e bolokilwe.
attachment-transfer-limits-title: Mellwane ya Bogolo bja Faele ya Dikgomaretšwa le API
attachment-upload-limit-label: Bogolo bjo bo fetago bja faele ya go laiša dikgomaretšwa
automatic-linked-url-schemes: Dikema tša URL tša tlwaelo tšeo di swanetšego go kgotlegega ka go itiriša. Sekema se tee sa URL mothalading
board-creation-admin-only: Batsamaisi feela ba ka hlama diboto tše difsa
board-view-product-backlog: Mešomo ya setšweletšwa ye e sa letilego
comment-assigned-only: Tshwayotshwayo go tše di abetšwego feela
confirm-move-list-to-swimlane: Iša lenaneo le le dikarata tša lona ka moka tseleng ye nngwe ya go sesa?
delete-board-confirm-popup: Mananeo ka moka, dikarata, dileibole le mešongwana di tla phumolwa gomme o ka se kgone go bušetša diteng tša boto. Ga go na go dirolla.
enable-permanent-delete: Dumelela go phumola ga sa ruri go Molaodi wa Kakaretšo
enable-permanent-delete-description: Dumelela Balaodi ba Kakaretšo go phumola ka sa ruri diteng tše di phumotšwego ka nakwana. Go bulela peakanyo ye ga go phumole selo ka boyona.
feature-approval-required: Boloka dikarolo tše di oketšwago ke dimpshafatšo tša WeKan di timilwe go fihlela molaodi a di bulela
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya boto → Kakaretšo e bontšha seo motho yo mongwe le yo mongwe a se dirilego botong letšatšing goba bekeng ya mafelelo, le seo se fetilwego ke nako.
feature-pilot-users: Badiriši ba teko bao ba bonago le dikarolo tše di timilwego
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Maina a badiriši, a arogantšwe ka difegelwana
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Di bolokilwe. Maina a a badiriši ga se a hwetšwa:
feature-preview-admins: Balaodi ba bona dikarolo tše di timilwego gore ba di leke pele
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya boto → Melao e šišinya melao go tšwa go seo batho ba se dirago ka seatla gantši.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Go nyaka ka moka go kwešiša dipolelwana tše bjalo ka "dikarata tša ka tše di fetilwego ke nako".
feature-since-last-visit: Go tloga ketelong ya gago ya mafelelo
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya boto → Go tloga ketelong ya gago ya mafelelo e bontšha seo ba bangwe ba se fetošitšego botong.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khalentara le khalentara ya dipoto tše dintši.
feature-views-chat-desc: Poto bjalo ka lefelo la poledišano: mafelo a mošomo, dipoto, ditsela, malokelelo le dikarata bjalo ka mohlare wa dikanale, karata gare gomme ditshwaotshwao tša yona bjalo ka melaetša ya poledišano.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Dikarata tše di swanago ka dihlopheng tše mmalwa tša dikholomo tše di nago le maina - go ya ka phetho, bohlokwa, kgato goba se sengwe - di šuthišwa magareng ga dikholomo ka go goga.
feature-views-email-desc: Poto bjalo ka lepokisi la poso: lelokelelo la imeile ke Lepokisi la tše di tsenago, malokelelo ke difoltara, diswayo ke diswayo, gomme maloko a ngwala le go araba diimeile go tšwa atreseng ya poto.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mošomo wo o šetšego le wo o phethilwego, kelelo ye e kgobokanego, nako ya modikologo le ya go iša, palo ya mošomo wo o phethilwego, nako ye mošomo o bilego gona ka yona, mapheko, Monte Carlo le dikelo tše dingwe tša kelelo.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Diponagalo tše tharo tša tšhate ya Gantt.
feature-views-map-desc: Dikarata bjalo ka maswao godimo ga seswantšho se se tsentšwego.
feature-views-overview-desc: Dipalopalo, go hlopha go ya ka motho yo a abetšwego, leano la tsela, poto ya taolo le poto ye kgolo.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Lenaneo la mešomo ya setšweletšwa, dipaka tše kopana tša mošomo, pego ya paka ya mošomo le lebelo.
feature-views-table-desc: Poto bjalo ka tafola ya dikarata tše di ka rulaganywago.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Boto bjalo ka sešala sa mathata sa GitHub goba Gitea: dikarata bjalo ka mathata, maleibole le dintlha tša bohlokwa, ditshwaelo bjalo ka poledišano, dikgokagano bjalo ka difaele, le histori ya boto le go phumola.
home-board-badge: Boto ya Gae (e bulwa ka morago ga go tsena)
home-board-empty: Goga boto e tee feela mo gore e bulwe ka morago ga go tsena
home-board-remove-confirm: Tloša boto ye go Gae? Boto ka boyona ga e phumolwe.
multi-selection-active: Kgotla mapokisi a go swaya gore o kgethe diboto
normal-assigned-only: Tlwaelo go tše di abetšwego feela
select-only-one-board: Hle kgetha boto e tee feela
set-selected-home: Beakanya bjalo ka boto ya Gae (e bulwa ka morago ga go tsena)
set-selected-starred: Tsenya naledi dibotong tše di kgethilwego
set-selected-unstarred: Tloša naledi dibotong tše di kgethilwego
unset-selected-home: Tloša peakanyo ya boto ya Gae
